newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan China Development mulls Philippine venture.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan China Development mulls Philippine venture.

text.p: China Development Corp, one of Taiwan's leading venture capital and investment firms, said on Wednesday it was negotiating to take part in a joint investment to take up to 40 percent of Air Philippines' stake.

Air Philippines is a private Philippine airline that operates domestic flights. "Seeing the potential market in the domestic Philippine airline market, China Development, Far East Air Transport Corp and likely foreign partners are negotiating to jointly invest in Air Philippines," company president Benny Hu told journalists.
"We will likely finalise the deal in April," Hu said.
Company chairman Liu Tai-ying added that his firm was also considering cooperating with Air Philippines in aircraft maintenance and related aerospace industry.
Detailed shares between partners in Air Philippines have yet to be set, said Brian Keng, vice-president of China Development.
"But according to rules there, foreign funds can take up to 40 percent of an airline company," Keng said.
The paid-in capital of Air Philippines is one billion pesos, Keng said. China Development currently holds 14 percent stake of Far East Air. -- Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
